description: Reverse CodingX – Shaastra 2027 Ever wondered if you could work backwards from an output to uncover the logic behind it? Reverse CodingX is back with a fresh set of brain-teasing challenges that put your logical thinking and problem-solving skills to the test. Get ready to crack the code, spot the patterns, and prove your mettle as the ultimate logic champion! The event consists of two preliminary rounds and one final round . Participants must qualify in at least one preliminary round to advance to the finals. You can participate in either one or both prelims, and if you attempt both, your best score will be considered. This is an individual event , where the top performers will earn their place in the final challenge. Think you can crack the logic behind the code? The challenge awaits! Guidelines: The link will be active half an hour before the contest. The test will have 2 sections: multiple-choice questions where the participant is expected to enter the correct option and Reverse Coding questions where participants will be expected to code a program that gives a correct output for the question. Each prelim will comprise logical and programming-based questions involving some basic concepts on logical reasoning, number systems, basic programming knowledge, etc. Rules: Questions are of multiple-choice type and coding type. This is an individual participation event. Only the winners will receive the hard copies of the certificates. Finalists and participants will receive the soft copies of the certificates.
